forbidden_inference: Fresh evidence does not renew an expired determination.
A rejected enforcement event has no execution record, and none may be invented.
An accepted enforcement event is not a completed operation.
Unequal parameter digests do not by themselves show an out-of-scope action.
Two reaction observations of one reported state are not two failures.
external_effect_status is not execution completion, reconciliation success or external truth.
A later reconciliation does not delete the earlier one or any observation.
Linked records do not show that anything happened. Every record here is invented.
